Physics::Optics.explanation: Violet, Indigo, Blue, Green, Yellow, Orange, Red — order of colours in the visible spectrum (shortest to longest wavelength is reversed: violet has shortest).

Physics::Electromagnetic Waves.phrase: Raging Martians Invaded Venus Using X-ray Guns
Physics::Electromagnetic Waves.explanation: Radio, Microwave, Infrared, Visible, Ultraviolet, X-ray, Gamma — order of EM spectrum by increasing frequency.

Physics::Magnetism.explanation: Left hand rule gives force direction in a MOTOR; right hand rule gives induced current direction in a GENERATOR. Thumb = Force/Motion, First finger = Field, Middle finger = Current.

Physics::Current Electricity.phrase: Better Be Right Or Your Great Big Venture Goes West
Physics::Current Electricity.explanation: Resistor colour code: Black(0), Brown(1), Red(2), Orange(3), Yellow(4), Green(5), Blue(6), Violet(7), Grey(8), White(9).

Physics::Kinematics.explanation: Five kinematic variables for uniform acceleration: S (displacement), U (initial velocity), V (final velocity), A (acceleration), T (time). Each kinematics equation drops one of these.

Physics::Thermodynamics.phrase: First law: ΔU = Q − W (system POV: heat IN, work OUT)
Physics::Thermodynamics.explanation: Energy in = Energy out. Heat added (Q positive) raises internal energy; work done by system (W positive) reduces it.

Physics::Modern Physics.explanation: Two foundations of quantum: Planck's photon energy and de Broglie matter waves. h = Planck's constant connects both.

Chemistry::Redox Reactions.explanation: Oxidation Is Loss (of electrons), Reduction Is Gain (of electrons). The species oxidised is the REDUCING agent; the species reduced is the OXIDISING agent.

Chemistry::Periodic Table.phrase: Happy Henry Likes Beer But Could Not Obtain Food (Group 1+2 + p-block row 2)
Chemistry::Periodic Table.explanation: H, He, Li, Be, B, C, N, O, F — first 9 elements in order. Pair with 'Nelly Naps Magnificently After Such Pleasant Sport, Cleopatra Arrived' for Ne, Na, Mg, Al, Si, P, S, Cl, Ar (period 3).

Chemistry::s-Block.explanation: Li, Na, K, Rb, Cs, Fr — Group 1 alkali metals top to bottom. Reactivity INCREASES down the group.

Chemistry::p-Block.phrase: Fancy Clara Brings Iodine At Tea
Chemistry::p-Block.explanation: F, Cl, Br, I, At — Group 17 halogens. Reactivity DECREASES down the group (opposite to Group 1).

Chemistry::Chemical Bonding.explanation: Common valences: Hydrogen 1, Oxygen 2, Nitrogen 3, Carbon 4. Memorise this and you can draw most organic Lewis structures.

Chemistry::Organic Chemistry.phrase: Meet Ethel, Pro-Buty, Pent the Hexer, Hep Octo Nona Deca
Chemistry::Organic Chemistry.explanation: IUPAC prefixes for 1–10 carbons: Meth, Eth, Prop, But, Pent, Hex, Hept, Oct, Non, Dec.

Chemistry::Hydrocarbons.explanation: In HX addition to an unsymmetric alkene, H goes to the carbon that ALREADY has more H atoms; X goes to the more substituted carbon. Peroxide effect (Kharasch) reverses it for HBr only.

Chemistry::Coordination Compounds.explanation: Strong field ligands (CN⁻, CO) cause LARGE splitting → low-spin complexes. Weak field ligands (I⁻, Br⁻, F⁻) cause SMALL splitting → high-spin. Spectrochemical series: I < Br < Cl < F < OH < H₂O < NH₃ < en < NO₂⁻ < CN⁻ < CO.

Chemistry::Mole Concept.phrase: Moles = Mass / Molar mass = Volume(STP) / 22.4 = Particles / 6.022×10²³
Chemistry::Mole Concept.explanation: Four ways to count moles. STP volume of any gas = 22.4 L/mol. Avogadro's number = 6.022 × 10²³.

Chemistry::Thermodynamics.phrase: ΔG = ΔH − TΔS  →  Spontaneous when ΔG < 0
Chemistry::Thermodynamics.explanation: Negative ΔH (exothermic) and positive ΔS (more disorder) favour spontaneity. At high T, ΔS dominates; at low T, ΔH dominates.

Biology::Cell Division.explanation: Stages of mitosis in order: Interphase, Prophase, Metaphase, Anaphase, Telophase. (Followed by cytokinesis.)

Biology::Genetics.explanation: DNA base pairing: Adenine pairs with Thymine (2 H-bonds), Guanine pairs with Cytosine (3 H-bonds). In RNA, T is replaced by Uracil.

Biology::Plant Kingdom.explanation: Plant kingdom main groups in order of complexity: Bryophyta, Pteridophyta, Gymnospermae, (With/and) Angiospermae. Add Algae before for completeness.

Biology::Animal Kingdom.phrase: King Philip Came Over For Good Soup
Biology::Animal Kingdom.explanation: Taxonomic ranks: Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species. Most NEET questions on classification follow this hierarchy.

Biology::Human Physiology.phrase: On Old Olympus' Towering Top, A Finn And German Viewed Some Hops
Biology::Human Physiology.explanation: 12 cranial nerves I–XII: Olfactory, Optic, Oculomotor, Trochlear, Trigeminal, Abducens, Facial, Auditory (Vestibulocochlear), Glossopharyngeal, Vagus, Spinal accessory, Hypoglossal.

Biology::Plant Physiology.explanation: Plant hormones: Brassinosteroids, Auxin, abscisic acid (Dormin = ABA), MAD = (more memory aids); core five: Auxin, Gibberellin, Cytokinin, Ethylene, ABA. Auxin/GA/Cyto PROMOTE growth; ABA/Ethylene INHIBIT (mostly).

Biology::Reproduction.phrase: Spermato-GO-CY-TE: Spermatogonium → Primary spermatocyte → Secondary spermatocyte → Spermatid → Sperm
Biology::Reproduction.explanation: Stages of spermatogenesis. Mirror on female side: Oogonium → Primary oocyte → Secondary oocyte → Ootid → Ovum.

Biology::Biomolecules.phrase: Carbs = (CH₂O)ₙ, Proteins = chains of 20 aa, Lipids = ester of glycerol + fatty acids, Nucleic acids = sugar+phosphate+base
Biology::Biomolecules.explanation: The four classes of biomolecules and their building blocks. NEET LOVES asking about which biomolecule has which monomer.

Biology::Ecology.phrase: Producers → Primary consumers → Secondary → Tertiary; only 10% energy transfers up (Lindeman's 10% law)
Biology::Ecology.explanation: Energy flow in ecosystem is one-directional and lossy. Biomagnification of toxins (DDT) goes UP the food chain; biomass goes DOWN.

Math::Trigonometry.explanation: Sin = Opposite/Hypotenuse, Cos = Adjacent/Hypotenuse, Tan = Opposite/Adjacent. Foundation of all right-triangle trig.

Math::Trigonometric Functions.explanation: Sign of trig functions by quadrant: Q1 = All positive, Q2 = Sin (and cosec) positive, Q3 = Tan (and cot) positive, Q4 = Cos (and sec) positive.

Math::Algebra.explanation: Order of operations: Brackets, Of/Orders (powers/roots), Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction. Same as PEMDAS.

Math::Binomial Theorem.explanation: Multiplying (a+b)(c+d): First (ac), Outer (ad), Inner (bc), Last (bd). Generalises to binomial theorem for (a+b)ⁿ.

Math::Probability.explanation: Addition rule — subtract the overlap. If A and B are mutually exclusive, P(A∩B) = 0. For independent events, P(A∩B) = P(A)·P(B).

Math::Permutations and Combinations.phrase: P for Position (order matters), C for Choice (order doesn't)
Math::Permutations and Combinations.explanation: ⁿPr = n!/(n−r)! when arrangement matters. ⁿCr = n!/(r!(n−r)!) when only selection matters. ⁿCr = ⁿPr / r!.

Math::Calculus.phrase: d/dx (xⁿ) = n·xⁿ⁻¹ — bring down, subtract one
Math::Calculus.explanation: Power rule for differentiation. For integration, REVERSE: add one to exponent, divide by new exponent. ∫xⁿ dx = xⁿ⁺¹/(n+1) + C.

Math::Vectors.explanation: a·b = |a||b|cosθ (scalar). a×b = |a||b|sinθ n̂ (vector, perpendicular to both, direction by right-hand rule). a·a = |a|², a×a = 0.

Math::Matrices.explanation: Three key rules: matrix multiplication is NOT commutative; inverse and transpose REVERSE the order when distributing over a product.
